parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the end time is the current query time.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The time interval. Unit: seconds. The value must be an integer multiple of 60.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of response codes. Valid values:
- **waf**: response codes returned by WAF to clients.
- **upstream**: response codes returned by origin servers to WAF.
